job.title: Retail Account Manager Teamwear
job.description:
Join an Established Sporting Brand in Western Australia

The Role
This is a hands-on account management role focused on building strong relationships with retailers, clubs, schools and commercial partners, identifying new business opportunities and delivering a high level of customer service throughout the sales and order lifecycle. As the key point of contact for WA retail accounts, you will be responsible for maintaining existing partnerships while driving sales growth and identifying opportunities to expand the business.


 Key responsibilities include:
  • Manage and develop WA retail customer accounts
  • Build strong relationships with retailers, clubs, schools and commercial partners
  • Identify new sales and business development opportunities
  • Manage licensed product sales to customers, retailers and AFL clubs
  • Handle customer enquiries, quotations and orders
  • Manage stock, custom football and indent orders
  • Communicate stock availability, backorders and expected lead times
  • Work closely with the warehouse to prioritise orders and distribution
  • Conduct regular backorder reporting and customer follow-up
  • Coordinate sales returns, warranty claims, replacements and repairs through Sage System
  • Liaise with Accounts regarding payments, credits, account holds and stock release
  • Assist with Eastern States customer enquiries when required

About You You will be an experienced Retail Account Manager who enjoys building relationships, growing accounts and providing excellent customer service.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • 5+ years' experience in account management, sales or business development
  • Experience managing retail or consumer-facing accounts
  • A proven track record of revenue growth and customer retention
  • Strong commercial negotiation and account planning skills
  • Sound analytical, reporting and forecasting capabilities
  • Strong commercial and business acumen
  • A customer-focused and relationship-driven approach
  • A strategic, growth-focused mindset
  • Strong accountability and a results-driven attitude
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills
If you are a proactive Account Manager who enjoys developing long-term customer relationships while driving commercial growth, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Sales & MTM Consultant | Luxury Menswear
job.description:

Rather than a traditional retail sales environment, this position focuses on understanding individual needs, providing personalised recommendations, and delivering a seamless customer journey.

  • A natural relationship builder with exceptional communication skills

  • Highly organised with strong follow-up and attention to detail

Enjoy a consistent roster with two consecutive days off each week:

Monday & Tuesday – Off

Sunday – 9:00am–5:00pm

If you're passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences and enjoy helping people feel their best, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Teamwear Sales Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Teamwear Sales Manager to drive growth across an established sporting brand’s custom teamwear business.This hands-on role combines new business development, account management and relationship building, working with sporting clubs, associations, leagues and schools from enquiry through to delivery. If you have a strong sales background, understand the sporting/teamwear market and enjoy winning new business, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
  • Drive new business across sporting clubs, associations, leagues and schools.
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline to achieve revenue and sales targets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and quoting through to design, production and delivery.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, including clubs, associations and schools.
  • Identify opportunities for repeat business, renewals and multi-year partnerships.
  • Prepare Quotes, proposals and tenders, and negotiate pricing within company guidelines.
  • Work with customers and design teams to develop customised teamwear, including branding, logos and player details.
  • Coordinate with design, production, warehouse and logistics teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
  • Proactively manage customer expectations around production and local and international delivery timeframes.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline activity and sales forecasts.
  • Represent the brand at sporting events, club expos and industry meetings to generate new opportunities.
  • Stay informed on teamwear products, market trends and competitor activity.

About You
You will bring a proven B2B sales background and a genuine understanding of the sporting or teamwear environment.
  
Experience
  • 5+ years' experience in B2B sales, account management or business development.
  • Experience selling into sporting clubs, associations, leagues or schools, or within teamwear/apparel.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and building a strong sales pipeline.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle from quoting through to order delivery.
  • Sound understanding of garment customisation, branding and production lead times.
  • Strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.
   
What You’ll Bring
  • Confident relationship builder who enjoys developing new business.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a results-driven approach.
  • Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to club committees and key stakeholders.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively across design, production and logistics.
  • Customer-focused, proactive and solutions-oriented.
  • Professional and ethical in all interactions with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Apply Now
If you have B2B sales experience and a passion for sport, teamwear and building customer relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Warehouse Supervisor
job.description:
Opportunity 
 We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Warehouse Supervisor to join an established and growing sporting brand.This is a key operational role responsible for supervising day-to-day warehouse activities and ensuring goods are received, stored, picked, packed and dispatched safely, accurately and efficiently.

About the Role
Working closely with the Production and Warehouse Manager, you will lead the warehouse team and help drive operational performance, inventory accuracy, customer service and WHS compliance.

 Key responsibilities include:
  • Supervise receiving, picking, packing, dispatch and stock replenishment
  • Coordinate daily workflow and prioritise tasks to meet operational demands
  • Oversee inbound goods, container unloading and stock put-away
  • Maintain inventory accuracy and high standards of warehouse organisation
  • Ensure safe operating procedures, housekeeping and equipment standards are maintained
  • Lead, coach and support warehouse employees
  • Monitor workflow and resolve operational issues
  • Use WMS systems to manage inventory and warehouse activity
  • Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability and teamwork
About You
We are looking for a hands-on leader with:
  • 3+ years’ experience in a warehouse or distribution supervisory role
  • Experience with WMS and inventory control
  • Strong knowledge of receiving, picking, packing and dispatch operations
  • Experience leading and coaching teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Sound understanding of WHS, manual handling and safe equipment operation
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
  • A proactive, reliable and safety-focused approach
  • The ability to lead by example and take ownership of warehouse performance
  • Must hold a current forklift licence

If you are an experienced warehouse professional looking for an opportunity to join an established sporting brand and make a real impact, we would love to hear from you! Apply Now

job.title: E-Commerce Coordinator Teamwear / Systems & Reporting
job.description:
General Purpose 
A great opportunity for someone who loves data, systems and process improvement. You’ll be the go-to person for Teamwear reporting and systems, providing clear visibility of orders, production, delivery and key performance metrics.

About the Role
Working closely with the Teamwear Manager and stakeholders across Production, Warehouse, Finance, Customer Service, IT and Account Management, you’ll ensure systems are fit for purpose, data is accurate, reporting is meaningful, and opportunities for improvement are identified and acted upon. It is a hands-on systems, data and process role that enables the wider Teamwear team to operate efficiently and gives leadership the visibility they need to make informed decisions.

Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards tracking orders, production, lead times, delivery performance and KPIs.
  • Consolidate data from multiple systems into accurate, actionable reporting for management.
  • Act as the Teamwear systems super user, maintaining data integrity and supporting day-to-day system administration.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and liaise with IT and external vendors to resolve more complex issues.
  • Identify trends, risks and process improvements to improve efficiency and data accuracy.
  • Support the rollout of new systems and process changes, including testing, documentation and training.
  • Collaborate with Production, Warehouse, Finance, Customer Service and IT to ensure accurate and effective information flow.
About You
You’re a data-driven problem solver who enjoys getting into the detail, understanding how systems work and finding better ways of doing things.
You’ll ideally bring:
  • 3+ years’ experience in systems, reporting, data, process coordination or a similar operational role.
  • Experience working with order management, ERP or production tracking systems.
  • Strong Excel skills, including experience building reports and dashboards using data from multiple sources.
  • Experience acting as a systems super user, including troubleshooting issues and working with IT teams or external vendors.
  • Experience in apparel, teamwear, manufacturing or a similar operational environment is highly desirable.
You’ll be someone who:
  • Is highly analytical with exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Is process-driven and genuinely enjoys continuous improvement.
  • Is a self-motivated problem solver who is comfortable navigating multiple systems.
  • Communicates confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Works collaboratively across Production, Warehouse, Finance, Customer Service and Teamwear.
  • Takes ownership and enjoys being the person others turn to when they need answers.
If you’re someone who enjoys making sense of data, solving systems challenges and finding smarter ways to work, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to take the next step in your career as our new Teamwear Systems & Reporting Coordinator.
